title: Teal color looks cheap...
text:
Teal color looks cheap.... The hands are a cheap tin like metal -very very thin, one looks already bent out of the box.

I am returning. I do like the size and the look of it, so I’m going to try the wood version.The teal just looks cheap.

Stay tuned I’ll share how the brown wood version looks.
